::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [April? 1869]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Harry Ransom Humanities Research Center, University of Texas, Austin
:::

My dear [[name erased](people/person_1301.qmd)]
I am sending you [Keightley](other_books/otherbook_212.qmd) by this post, I must ask Macmillan to send you Pearson as I have only got a [Mudie](organizations/other_137.qmd)’s copy here –[^1] I think I shall go to [Brighstone](organizations/other_140.qmd) in Whitsunweek, when I would try to get to Bonchurch to see you

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: CMY visited the Moberlys at Brightstone in May 1869.
[^2]: Probably Thomas Keightley, *The Crusaders, or, Scenes, Events and Characters from the Times of the Crusades* (London: Parker, 1834).
